share: Add missing shared key times across the active animation channels.
share_last: Use the last selected object as the source of key times for the other selected objects.
reblock: Re-space animation blocks while preserving their keyed poses.
reblock_insert: Insert reblocked timing without replacing the destination timing.
bake_1: Bake the active animation context on every frame.
bake_2: Bake the active animation context every two frames.
bake_3: Bake the active animation context every three frames.
bake_4: Bake the active animation context every four frames.
bake_custom: Bake using a custom positive frame interval.
bake_last: Bake selected targets at the key times of the last selected object.
